name: vtk.js
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Kitware's VTK for the browser: volumes, meshes, medical and scientific rendering
summary: Visualization Toolkit ported to WebGL JavaScript: volume rendering, isosurfaces, polydata, transfer functions, widgets and readers for scientific formats. Driven from JavaScript in a browser page; output is canvas pixels. Strength is scientific-grade volume and mesh rendering that Three.js lacks out of the box.
use_when: Volume rendering or isosurfaces of scalar data (CT, simulation grids)
Over Three.js when the input is VTK, VTI or VTP datasets
Scientific scenes needing transfer functions and clipping planes
avoid_when: General scenes and models: Three.js or Babylon.js

assessment.rationale: Active (37.4.6, 2026-10-21) with frequent releases. Only catalogued route to volume and scientific dataset rendering in a browser; frames are capturable with Playwright. Large bundle and a steeper API than Three.js.

notes: 2026-10-26: headless WebGL capture of volume rendering not tested.
